objective: Test whether two frozen, economically distinct hard-valid strategy specifications improve account-level after-cost geometric growth and reduce positive-trade concentration when their raw eligible signals are replayed in one four-asset account with one global slot.
portfolio_hypothesis: The dynamic factor rank-transition state-exit strategy earns from cross-sectional idiosyncratic trend transfer, while aligned displacement/flow continuation earns from high-activity information acceptance. If their event clocks and symbol contributions are sufficiently independent, a deterministic one-slot router may admit more distinct positive-expectancy events and reduce dependence on the largest residual-trend trades without fitted weights or concurrent leverage.

components.signal_and_exit_rule: Use the exact reconstructed state_exit.py and base dynamic_factor_residual.py definitions. No feature, entry, exit or parameter change is allowed.
components.known_2024_exposure: Four multi-component portfolios containing this candidate or related frozen arms were previously evaluated in 2024 and all lost. The exact single candidate and the cross-family portfolio in this study were not previously evaluated. Therefore 2024 is a one-shot fixed integration comparison but not pristine at the dynamic-family level.

components.signal_and_exit_rule: Use the exact reconstructed absorption-flow source for the registered candidate. No feature, event-clock, entry, target, stop, maximum-lifetime or parameter change is allowed.
components.known_2024_exposure: No sequential 2024 selection was opened for this exact specification because its registered yearly gate failed.

source_reconstruction.dynamic_source: Verify the SHA-registered dynamic-factor verified source set and reproduce its 2023 candidate metrics before any 2024 evaluation.
source_reconstruction.absorption_source: Reconstruct the SHA-registered source.part bundle from the frozen branch and reproduce its registered 2022-2023 candidate metrics before any 2024 evaluation.
source_reconstruction.failure_rule: If either component cannot reproduce its registered development result within floating-point tolerance, no 2024 portfolio outcome is admissible.

evaluation_data.market: Official Binance Vision USD-M BTCUSDT, ETHUSDT, SOLUSDT and XRPUSDT one-minute bars, aggregated to exact complete five-minute bars where required.
evaluation_data.mark_and_funding: Official mark-price open and actual fundingRate calc_time. Use exact mark open at settlement and exact contract open only as a documented fallback.
evaluation_data.data_availability: Every component receives only completed observations available under its original contract.

router.raw_signal_requirement: Regenerate every eligible component signal before the component's own position suppression. Executed component ledgers may be used only for equivalence audits and never as the portfolio signal source.
router.global_slot: A pending order or open position from either component blocks all other new entries until actual exit.
router.entry_order: Chronological intended entry time after each component's causal delay.
router.simultaneous_conflict: DYNAMIC_STATE_021FBAB613517A31 first, then ABSORPTION_ALIGNED_33034B092FFD271A. This priority is fixed because the dynamic specification is the current project first place before the integration result; no 2024 score or return is used.
router.position_management: After entry, only the owning frozen component manages its stop, state/target exit and maximum lifetime. The other component cannot modify, add to or reverse the position.

common_account_contract.funding: Actual settlements in (entry, exit] valued with exact mark open and documented exact contract-open fallback only.
common_account_contract.daily_growth_denominator: all UTC calendar days in 2024, including non-trading days
common_account_contract.mark_to_liquidation_nav: Required at every UTC day end for any candidate that is positive at 18bp.

evaluation_metrics: total return and geometric daily growth at 18/24/30bp
profit factor and median account return
bar-level marked-to-liquidation maximum drawdown and recovery duration
return after removing the largest 1%, 5% and 10% positive trades
component, symbol, direction, month and quarter contributions
accepted, blocked and simultaneous signals by component
funding and modeled execution cost contribution

comparison_policy.normalization: Compare the three accounts on the identical 2024 dataset, costs, funding, risk, capacity and NAV contract. Do not compare raw historical development metrics as though they were normalized.
comparison_policy.2024_interpretation: Because the dynamic family has prior 2024 portfolio exposure, any positive result is provisional integration evidence, not pristine sequential OOS validation.

prohibitions: No component parameter or signal change.
No portfolio weight, priority or threshold fitting from 2024.
No executed-ledger summation as a substitute for raw signal regeneration.
No target-return, risk or leverage fitting.
No paper, testnet or live orders.
